messages:
sara_sales: Heads up / Nimbus partner requests a joint co-sell POC: Redwood Dedicated in partner VPC, SSO (SAML/OIDC), customer-managed keys (HSM), telemetry export to their Splunk, and a pricing sketch for bursty startup traffic. Can we do a quick handoff and call? cc @ana_partner

ana_partner: Thanks Sara. Requirements: data to stay in partner VPC, EU region primary, p90 latency <=150ms, typical context 512 tokens (spikes to 2048). Need per-tenant audit logs.

sam_se: Ill lead tech presales. Questions: expected sustained QPS vs burst? cold-start tolerance? Proposed two-track: sandbox (1 small GPU + hosted fallback) and pilot (3 reserved GPUs, KV cache, canary). Deliverables: topology ASCII, SSO flow, egress plan, load script, security answers.

sara_sales: They said sustained ~20 qps, burst ~200 concurrent users first month. Cold starts OK if we warm prefix cache. p90 goal = 150ms.

sam_se: I'll produce a minimal k6/curl load snippet and a 1-page runbook for canary rollouts. Example quick test:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-large","input":"Summarize this","max_tokens":256}'

lee_eng: Pricing ops: suggest 3-month pilot with 50% baseline commit + burst credits billed usage with 20% partner discount for first quarter. Provisioning lead time for dedicated GPUs ~8-10 business days; hosted fallback for faster start.

lee_eng: Telemetry: we can export aggregated token counts, per-tenant p50/p90 latency histograms, and sampled traces to their collector. Provide telemetry schema and sampling guidance. No raw PII exported.

eng-security-bot: Confirmed: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported for Private/Dedicated. SOC2 pack link: https://s3.example.com/redwood/soc2-pack.pdf. Eng-security will review vendor questionnaire within 48h.

sara_sales: Plan: 1) Kickoff call tomorrow 10:00 PT confirm? 2) Sam: load harness + topology by EOD. 3) Lee: pricing sketch + security pack by EOD. 4) Ana: confirm partner CIDR and telemetry endpoint.

sam_se: Ack. I'll prep the harness and a short runbook.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: 'Nimbus joint POC kickoff' scheduled 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Invites: sara_sales, sam_se, lee_eng, ana_partner, eng-security-bot.

sara_sales: I'll circulate the 1-page runbook before the call. :thumbsup:
